title: Transferable LINK-XTB primitive-Hessian correction
summary: Fit the smallest transferable positive primitive-Hessian correction selected by an immutable sequential plateau rule.
coordinate_policy: Transform both harmonic Hessians on the same complete frozen R/A/SOOP primitive pool supplied by SMITH; experimental fundamentals are forbidden as targets. Inspect increasing factor counts once: from five factors onward, stop at the first point retaining mean overlap >= 0.85 for which each of the last two relative frequency-RMS gains is <= 6%.
backend_policy: TRINITY owns representation changes; ARCHITECT fits shared factors; atom-type modulation uses Mayer bond orders and, only if selected, SCC charges from the same LINK-XTB state; external-QM populations are forbidden; every off-diagonal factor is the geometric mean of its diagonal factors. Every family retains a baseline, and unseen atom types fall back to it with a unit modifier.
